body: **Texto do dia:** charge, tirinha e cartum.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar o futuro perfeito contínuo (will have been -ing) para falar da duração de uma ação até um momento futuro, numa tirinha.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: The Endless Negotiation

bubbles: By June, we will have been negotiating for two years.
And by then, I will have been drinking cold coffee for two years.
Next month I will have been working on this clause for six months.
Will you have been sleeping at all?
By the time we sign, we will have been talking longer than the treaty will last.

blocks.say: Say how long they will have been negotiating.

items.q: By June they will have been negotiating for two years.

head: Forma
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: By June, we **will have been negotiating** for two years.
**Will you have been sleeping** at all?
by + data; by the time; for + duração
will have + pp (resultado) × will have been -ing (duração)

blocks.body: Use o **futuro perfeito contínuo** para enfatizar a **duração** de uma ação que continua até um momento futuro: *By June I will have been working here for ten years.*
Verbos de estado (know, be, have) normalmente não vão para o contínuo: ✗ *will have been knowing* ✓ *will have known*.

items.s: By June, we will have been ___ for two years. (negotiate)
Next month I will ___ been working on this clause for six months. (have)
Will you have been ___ at all? (sleep)
By the time we sign, we ___ have been talking for years. (will)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Yes since I was a child

body: **Yes, since I was a child.** — Sim, desde criança.
**How long will you have been working here by next year?** — Há quanto tempo você estará trabalhando aqui no ano que vem?
**By next year I will have been working here for ten years.** — No ano que vem estarei trabalhando aqui há dez anos.

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Organização da informação pela entonação: a informação nova ou final recebe a nota que cai; listas e ideias incompletas sobem.
words: We need time ↗, money ↗, and trust ↘.
If it fails ↗, we try again ↘.
Having left early ↗, she missed it ↘.

prompts.q: Say how long you will have been studying by December.
prompts.model: By December I will have been studying English for three years.

prompts.q: Ask a question in the future perfect continuous.
prompts.model: How long will you have been working by then?

prompts.q: Contrast will have finished and will have been working.
prompts.model: By June I will have finished the report; I will have been writing it for months.

blocks.task: Write 6 sentences using will have been + -ing about your life, work or studies in the future.
blocks.model: By next year, I will have been studying for five years. By June, my team will have been working on the project for eight months. By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for an hour. In 2030, she will have been living abroad for a decade. Will you have been sleeping well by then? I won’t have been wasting time.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
